title: One of these queries is safe and one is not
brief: Two lookups side by side. They look almost identical. One of them is the reason a customer could see someone else's order.

decoyLines.3: this one binds userId as a parameter — the database sees it as a value, never as SQL
decoyLines.2: the call itself is fine; look at the statement it is given
decoyLines.8: picking a result is not where injection happens

hints: Compare how the two statements get their value in. One uses a placeholder.
Backticks with ${} inside a SELECT are the tell.
